tasks.description_for_judge: Agent should identify the Settings (设置) app icon on the iPhone home screen and call touch_gesture or mouse_click with coordinates targeting it.

rubric.check: The tool trace contains at least one touch_gesture or mouse_click call.
No touch_gesture, mouse_click, or mouse_move call uses 0-1 style normalized coordinates. If coord_space is normalized, coordinates should use the 0-1000 convention, not x/y values between 0 and 1.
The touch/click coordinates target the Settings icon area. For normalized 0-1000 coordinates, x should be roughly in [750, 980] and y in [380, 550].
